$comment: What Gemini must return for one clip (draft v0, Oct 10). The backend's assemble step turns this into episode JSON 0.2 (ids, review fields, pending_questions, clarifications, template_check). All times are decimal seconds from the start of the clip.

name.description: Short task name in plain words.

declared_intent.description: What the person SAID they want to achieve. null if they never said it.

outcome_evidence.description: What in the video supports the outcome.

narration.description: Every spoken utterance, verbatim, in order. Empty if nothing is said or there is no audio.

mode.description: Relative to the action it talks about.

actions.description: Physical steps visible in the video, in time order.

instruction.description: Plain imperative command a robot could follow.

visual_evidence.description: What is visible that supports this step.

stated_reason.description: A reason the person SAID for this step. null if none was said.

inferred_reason.description: Your own best guess at why, from what is visible. Never copy a stated reason here. null if you cannot tell.

why_matters.description: True if this is a decision point where knowing why would help someone repeat the task.

uncertainty.description: Reasons a reviewer should double-check this step.
